rationale: The only code-level change is a Windows-specific guard that treats INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE as a duplication failure before calling DuplicateHandle. The Logic section describes platform-specific duplication, Windows DuplicateHandle option handling, and POSIX reuse versus duplication to preserve descriptor validity; all of these claims hold for both implementations. It does not mention validation of invalid Windows handles or any behavior specific to either side of the patch.
